query: SELECT ms.name as set_name, mc.cardType, COUNT(*) as cnt, LEFT(MIN(mc.imageUrl), 100) as sample_url FROM marvel_cards mc JOIN marvel_sets ms ON mc.setId = ms.id WHERE mc.imageUrl IS NOT NULL AND mc.imageUrl NOT LIKE '%CBH-%' AND mc.imageUrl NOT LIKE '%placeholder%' AND mc.imageUrl NOT LIKE '%hulk-comic%' AND mc.imageUrl NOT LIKE '%generic%' GROUP BY ms.name, mc.cardType ORDER BY ms.name, mc.cardType;
